snowmobile.lore.legendary: Crossed the whole frozen north in one week delivering soup, and the soup was still too hot to drink when it arrived.

sports_car.lore.rare: Went round the roundabout so fast that it drove into its own exhaust smoke from the lap before.
sports_car.lore.legendary: Took the twisty coast road so smoothly that the passenger's ice cream was still a perfect swirl at the other end.

steam_locomotive.lore.epic: Pulled a train so long up the valley that the guard at the back had to send the driver a postcard.
steam_locomotive.lore.legendary: Chuffed up the steepest mountain railway with a brass band on its roof, and the band never missed a note.

tanker.lore.legendary: Delivered so much heating oil in one winter that every boiler in the city purred, and the cats all slept by the radiators.

taxi.lore.legendary: Took a passenger to the airport so fast that they caught yesterday's flight.

tow_truck.lore.epic: Towed every stuck car off the snowy motorway in one long line, and the drivers thought they had boarded a train.

x_cultivator.lore.epic: Churned the whole valley so finely in one week that the moles moved out and opened a guesthouse next door.
x_cultivator.lore.legendary: Dug a field so deep that it turned up the farmer's grandad's lost tractor, with the keys still in it.

x_hay_baler.lore.rare: Accidentally baled the farmer's hat, jacket and lunchbox, and he had to buy them back from the hay merchant.
x_hay_baler.lore.epic: Baled every field on the farm in one sunny day, then baled the scarecrow too. He now stands inside a very neat cube.

x_plough.lore.uncommon: Turns the soil upside down, and the worms always come up looking surprised.

x_seed_drill.lore.legendary: Sowed sunflowers so evenly that the whole field turns its heads to follow the farmer on his tractor.

x_snow_plough_truck.lore.uncommon: Wears chains on its tyres and jingles down the road like a sleigh.
x_snow_plough_truck.lore.epic: Cleared every road in town in one night and piled the snow so high on the roundabout that children skied down it for a week.

tractor.lore.rare: Pulled so hard on a stuck tree stump that the whole hedge came with it, birds and all.
tractor.lore.epic: Led every tractor in the county to the harvest parade, and the jam was so slow that the corn grew another inch.
tractor.lore.legendary: Ploughed a field so big that by the time it reached the far end, the near end needed ploughing again.

x_funicular.lore.epic: Ran up and down the cliff all fireworks night, and its twin car got so dizzy it waved at itself in the middle.
x_funicular.lore.legendary: Crept up the cliff so slowly one foggy morning that the café at the top sent breakfast down to the passengers on the way.

x_model_train.lore.legendary: Ran so many laps of the loft in one weekend that the tiny station master in the model village retired to the seaside.

x_toy_train.lore.epic: Pulled every toy in the playroom round the track in one long line, and the teddy at the back fell asleep before the last bend.
x_toy_train.lore.legendary: Built itself a wooden track from the playroom to the biscuit tin, and nobody has worked out who keeps adding pieces.

train.lore.legendary: Ran so precisely for a whole year that every cuckoo clock in town waited for its horn before cuckooing.

x_chairlift.lore.epic: Ran so fast on the busiest day that skiers reached the top before finishing their hot chocolate, and skied down holding the mugs.
x_chairlift.lore.legendary: Carried a snowman to the top for a dare, and he skied down faster than anyone in the resort.

x_gondola_lift.lore.common: Fogs up on cold days, so everyone draws smiley faces on the glass and the view disappears.
x_gondola_lift.lore.epic: Carried every hiker down before the storm so fast that some arrived at the bottom holding someone else's sandwich.
x_gondola_lift.lore.legendary: Floated so high that a passenger threw a paper aeroplane out of the window, and it landed in the next country.

tram.lore.epic: Stopped dead in the middle of market day, and by lunchtime the stallholders had set up shop all along its sides.
tram.lore.legendary: Rang its bell so often in one day that every bicycle bell in town learned the tune, and now they ding in harmony.

x_boat_trailer.lore.epic: Backed every boat into the harbour for the summer regatta, then backed itself in too and floated about with the dinghies.
x_boat_trailer.lore.legendary: Carried the same little boat to the beach so many summers that the boat now refuses to float unless the trailer is watching.

x_car_carrier.lore.epic: Delivered a new car to every showroom in the country in one week, and dropped off its own driver at one by mistake.
x_car_carrier.lore.legendary: Carried ten new cars from one end of the country to the other, and every one of them still showed zero miles.

x_dump_trailer.lore.legendary: Tipped up so high one day that it stuck that way, and the town uses it as a slide every summer.

x_horse_trailer.lore.legendary: Carried a pony to the beach so smoothly that it stepped out, built a sandcastle with its hooves and refused to go home.

x_logging_truck.lore.epic: Carried a tree so tall down the mountain road that the squirrels at the top end got off at the next village.
x_logging_truck.lore.legendary: Carried a log so huge that the town carved it into a canoe, and the whole football team paddled it to their match.

x_monster_truck.lore.legendary: Did a backflip clean out of the stadium and landed on all four wheels in the car park, perfectly between the lines.

x_salt_spreader.lore.epic: Gritted every road in the county before dawn, and the seagulls followed it inland thinking it was serving chips.

x_semi_trailer.lore.common: Parks in the lay-by with its fridge humming all night, so the whole campsite thinks there's a bear.
x_semi_trailer.lore.legendary: Carried enough eggs to fill every supermarket in the country, and never cracked one, even over the cattle grid.

x_street_sweeper.lore.rare: Sucked up a whole pile of autumn leaves just as the children ran to jump in, then sneezed them all back out.

x_toy_truck.names.legendary: Big Bruiser, Toughest in the Toybox

x_tractor_trailer.lore.rare: Took a corner so wide that it collected a hedge, a bus shelter sign and a very surprised scarecrow.
x_tractor_trailer.lore.epic: Drove so fast through the night that it delivered the shop's winter coats in the middle of summer.
x_tractor_trailer.names.legendary: Big Rig Ruby of Route Nine

truck.lore.epic: Got stuck under the low bridge on the busiest day, and the whole town helped by letting its tyres down one breath at a time.
truck.lore.legendary: Delivered a whole circus big top, ringmaster and all, and set it up by mistake in the supermarket car park.

van.lore.legendary: Fitted so much into one move that the family unpacked for a week and found a garden shed they never owned.

i_cash_machine.lore.epic: Gave out only crisp new notes all morning, and the whole town spent the afternoon too nervous to fold them.
i_cash_machine.lore.legendary: Counted out a million notes in one day without a mistake, then printed a receipt so long it reached the bank manager's house.

x_baby_carriage.lore.legendary: Rocked a whole nursery of crying babies to sleep in one lap of the park, and the parents had their first hot cup of tea in a year.

x_hand_truck.lore.epic: Delivered every crate on the high street before the shops opened, and stacked the last one so high the baker had to climb it for flour.
x_hand_truck.lore.legendary: Wheeled a whole mountain of potatoes into the chip shop in one morning, and the town had chips for tea every day for a month.

x_pram.lore.epic: Had so many toys hung from its handle that it jingled through the market like a one-pram band.
x_pram.lore.legendary: Was pushed round the park so many times that it wore a path the council now calls Pram Lane.

x_stroller.lore.legendary: Folded itself so small at the bus stop that it fitted in the baby's pocket, and nobody has managed to unfold it since.

x_bollard.lore.common: Stands just short enough that you only notice it when your shin finds it first.

x_classic_car.lore.legendary: Was so loved that the family towed it on holiday behind the new car, just so it could see the sea.

x_combine_harvester.lore.common: Is so wide that it folds its front up like a sleepy bat to squeeze through the field gate.
x_combine_harvester.lore.legendary: Harvested enough wheat for a loaf for everyone in the country, and still found the farmer's car keys in the last row.

x_convertible_car.lore.rare: Opened its roof in the car wash by mistake, and the driver came out cleaner than the car.

x_coupe.lore.uncommon: Has doors so long that it can only open them in a very empty car park.
x_coupe.lore.epic: Cruised through the city at night so shinily that every shop window it passed thought it had a new display.
x_coupe.lore.legendary: Looked so smart at the lights that the statue in the square turned its head to watch it go.

x_discus.lore.legendary: Has been thrown for so many thousands of years that it now chooses where to land, mostly near the ice cream van.

x_electric_car.lore.rare: Plugged itself into the neighbour's house by mistake and switched off their kettle halfway through boiling.
x_electric_car.lore.epic: Queued with a hundred other electric cars at the charger, and they all hummed the same note until the café closed.

x_formula_one_car.lore.legendary: Drove upside down along the tunnel ceiling at the city race to prove it could, and the tunnel lights still have tyre marks.

x_frisbee_disc.lore.epic: Was thrown round the park by every dog at once, and finally landed in the duck pond, where the ducks kept it as a raft.

x_hatchback_car.lore.epic: Did the school run, the big shop and the tip run in one morning, and a bag of compost came home in the child seat.
x_hatchback_car.lore.legendary: Found a parking space right outside the beach café on a bank holiday Monday, and the whole town came to take a photo.

x_hearse.lore.legendary: Drives so gently that a robin rides on its roof every morning and has never once had to flap.

x_hockey_puck.lore.legendary: Was slapped so hard in the final that it flew out of the rink, across town, and landed on the ice at next season's opening game.

x_hot_rod.lore.common: Fills up at the petrol station, drives one lap of the block, and needs filling up again.
x_hot_rod.lore.epic: Roared down the drag strip so fast that its painted flames peeled off and finished the race by themselves.
x_hot_rod.lore.legendary: Was built from three old cars in a garage, and the three of them still argue about who gets to steer.

x_hybrid_car.lore.legendary: Drove so efficiently for a year that the petrol station sent it a get-well-soon card.

x_limousine.lore.legendary: Was so long that it picked up the bride from her house and the groom from his at the same time.
x_limousine.lore.epic: Drove the whole school to the prom in one trip, and still had room in the back for the school bus.

x_manhole.lore.epic: Was left open during the parade, and the brass band marched round it in a perfect circle for an hour.
x_manhole.lore.legendary: Let a workman climb down at breakfast who popped up at teatime on the other side of the city, holding a lost cat.

x_minicar.lore.legendary: Fit forty clowns inside for the circus parade, and still had room for the umbrella.
x_minicar.lore.epic: Was lifted by four strong friends into the hotel lobby as a joke, and the hotel kept it as a sofa.

x_muscle_car.lore.legendary: Rumbled through every town on the long road west so deeply that every diner's jukebox skipped to its favourite song.
x_muscle_car.lore.epic: Rumbled down main street with fifty others on parade night, and the bakery's bread rose twice as fast.

x_parking_meter.lore.epic: Swallowed so many coins one Saturday that it burst open and paid for everyone's parking until Monday.
x_parking_meter.lore.legendary: Ticked so slowly for the wedding car that the whole ceremony, the cake and the first dance fitted inside one coin.

x_placard.lore.legendary: Held up a message so funny at the cup final that both teams stopped to laugh, and the referee asked for a photo.

x_rally_car.lore.legendary: Raced through deserts, forests and snow, and came home with a cactus, a pine cone and a snowball still on its roof.

x_road_sign.lore.epic: Got a new arrow painted on by mistake and sent the whole carnival parade through the car wash.
x_road_sign.lore.legendary: Pointed to its village so clearly that a lost hot-air balloon read it from the sky and landed in the square.

x_roadster.lore.common: Has a bonnet so long that the driver reaches the junction a whole second after the car.
x_roadster.lore.legendary: Took every hairpin on the mountain pass so neatly that the goats now use its tyre marks as a footpath.

x_scoreboard_sign.lore.epic: Showed the score backwards in the cup final, and both teams celebrated at once until the referee checked his notebook.
x_scoreboard_sign.lore.legendary: Kept counting so faithfully that after the stadium closed for the night, it scored the pigeons' football match too.

x_sign_board.lore.legendary: Swung so hard in a storm that it flew down the high street and hung itself outside the bakery, which now has two names.

x_smart_car.lore.legendary: Was lifted onto a delivery van's roof by mistake, and has toured the whole country since without using a drop of fuel.
x_smart_car.lore.epic: Turned round in the narrowest street of the old town in one go, and the tour guide added it to the tour.

x_spinning_top.lore.legendary: Spun so fast on the kitchen table that it drilled through to the flat below, and the neighbours got a free spinning top.

x_station_wagon_car.lore.rare: Folded its back seats flat and became the best seat at the outdoor cinema, with nine children and a dog in pyjamas.
x_station_wagon_car.lore.legendary: Was packed so full for the summer holiday that granny was found in the roof box at the first service station, waving.

x_stock_car.lore.common: Has more stickers than paint, and adds one every time it bumps someone.
x_stock_car.lore.epic: Did so many laps of the oval that it wore a groove, and the next race had to be run in the groove like a marble run.

x_stop_sign.lore.epic: Was put up in the middle of the marathon route, and ten thousand runners stopped, looked both ways and carried on.
x_stop_sign.lore.legendary: Made a million cars stop exactly in time, and one morning a runaway snail too, which waited politely before crossing.

x_street_lamp.lore.legendary: Shone so warmly one snowy night that the hedgehogs held a party under it, and the snow melted in a perfect circle.

x_toy_car.lore.legendary: Rolled down the stairs, through the cat flap and down the hill, and turned up in the toy shop window at the bottom of town.

x_vintage_car.lore.epic: Drove to the seaside so slowly that the passengers got out at a village fête, had tea and still caught up.
x_vintage_car.lore.legendary: Finished the run to the sea so many times that the sea now comes out at low tide to meet it.
